China

Overview

A summer trip to China to visit family, flying between Pittsburgh and Shanghai via Dallas, with a high-speed train trip to Beijing. It's my kids' first times visiting China. The itinerary includes family visits, reunions with friends, sightseeing in Shanghai and Beijing, and birdwatching.

eBird trip report.
